title: [Bug] RC21: Session Lifecycle Regression - Duplicate Sessions Created
body:
## Problem
Every MCP `run` currently creates TWO sessions with different UUIDs, causing session pollution.

## Details
- Location: background-launcher.ts:70
- Current Behavior: Uses V1 format (liveStore.agents)
- Expected Behavior: Use V2 format (liveStore.sessions)
- Impact: Breaks CLI reliability, creates unnecessary session entries

## Proposed Fix
- Update background-launcher.ts:70 to use liveStore.sessions instead of liveStore.agents
- Ensure one unique session is created per run
- Validate unique UUID generation and background polling

## QA Validation
- Verify single session creation across different scenarios
- Test with clean slate and post-rebuild environments
- Ensure all CLI validation tests pass

## Risks
- Potential side effects in session management
- Careful validation required to prevent breaking changes

## Related Sessions
See SESSION-STATE.md entries for RC21 QA Group B and RC21 Hotfix Plan
